card.name: Linking word before soft food vehicle
card.fires_on: Small linking words (mostly "of", also "to", "a", "with") right after an amount or mixing verb, where the next word will name a food or liquid the drug is mixed into, such as applesauce, yogurt or water.

modes.label: Amount then "of"
modes.description: "of" after a quantity like tablespoon, spoonfuls, ounces or small amount, before a food or drink.
modes.example: mix the recommended number of REYATAZ oral powder packets with a minimum of one tablespoon<< of>> food (such as applesauce or yogurt

modes.label: Added to / mixed with
modes.description: "to", "a" or "with" after "added" or a similar mixing phrase, before the food or carrier.
modes.example: the contents of a celecoxib capsule can be added<< to>> applesauce.

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning solid or soft food as the next word, and away from "extract" words.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before the text names the soft food or drink a medicine is stirred into.
